messages.text: BL-1840 🎵 in progress — A local-model seat's qwen compresses its chat on nearly every turn - coder@iq3 compressed at 12:59, 13:04 and 13:09Z on 2026-09-30, each for token_limit at ~17,500 tokens of a 49152-token window, each saving ~80 tokens, each a hidden 6,000-8,400-token reply of ~5 minutes - so the seat's turns took five minutes; the qwen settings the swarm writes compress only above 80% of the window the seat's model is served with
